freshnessPolicy.description: Sources with a verifiedAt date older than recommendedMaxAgeDays should be treated as insufficient for a conclusive supported/unsupported result; report the assessment as unknown/incomplete instead of relying on stale evidence.

notes: This is a community-maintained seed dataset covering Magento Open Source and Adobe Commerce 2.4.6 through 2.4.9 against MySQL and MariaDB. It was authored from Adobe's published system-requirements documentation and is intentionally conservative: any database version not covered by an explicit rule below is reported as 'unknown', never assumed unsupported. Corrections and extensions (including a future MariaDB Foundation-maintained data source, discussed for this dataset) are welcome via pull request.

migrations.notes: MariaDB is a drop-in replacement for MySQL for versions of Magento Open Source/Adobe Commerce that officially support it (2.4.7 and later, per this dataset). Back up the database and test thoroughly in a staging environment before switching a production instance.
